verdict.rationale: Fellow documents capturing in-person meetings, but only through desktop audio capture. It also states that every conversation becomes searchable through a full transcript in the workspace, and it supports audio uploads. No mobile app is evidenced anywhere, so the mobile-capture core of the story is unproven. Missing for 10: a documented mobile recording app, evidence that mobile-captured in-person notes sync into the same searchable workspace, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can record and transcribe in-person conversations from a mobile app, and those notes land in the same searchable workspace

citations.quote: capturing audio directly from the desktop across Zoom, Google Meet, Microsoft Teams, Slack Huddles, and in-person meetings
Every conversation becomes searchable through a full transcript, giving your team instant access to past context whenever they need it.
